title: #TheMallWorld IRL
content: Whenever I step on the escalators at The Actual Mall, I get zapped back to that feeling in my dreams of being in The Mall World/Lumania. It feels so real in the dream, but then you wake up and all the distance comes between us. Even though you guys aren't physically here, I can feel still feel you. I'm at [The Mall now](https://youtu.be/yUY9tn9rTF8?si=1GopmkltOsGijPxp) but the sound is scuffed. Either way...somehow I feel we are still connected. And who knows, it is Valentine's Day...maybe The One is here. [Background Song: Eden](https://youtu.be/ruuZl_ziMRI?si=CFbRIaLkoHDOGcaW)
